text: But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper. THE END
title: Page 14 - Supper for the Good Bunnies
director_note: The final tableau holds on the three good sisters gathered peacefully at supper, letting their calm eating and small smiles answer Peter's earlier chaos. Ending with a quiet rest and "THE END" gives the page a warm, earned sense of home and reward.
